headline: Vanishing Horizons
subhead: A visual journey through the eroding coastlines of the world's most vulnerable islands.
author: Sarah Jenkins

content.caption: The Maldives at low tide. For now.

content.text: It happens gradually, then suddenly. The creeping oceans claim millimeters of sand a year until a storm surge takes the rest. For the inhabitants of low-lying island nations, climate change isn't an abstract scientific projection; it is the water at their doorstep.

content.caption: Seawalls built in Tuvalu to hold back the king tides.

content.text: Adaptation takes many forms. Reinforced concrete barriers rise where mangroves used to flourish. Whole communities plan relocations. The culture is forced to shift as the geography dictates.

content.caption: A lone fisherman casts a net where his village once stood.
